questions.question: Describe two patterns in nature using maths words.
questions.expected_answer: Honeycomb is a tessellation of hexagons with no gaps. A leaf usually has one line of symmetry along its middle vein. A flower with 5 equal, evenly spaced petals has 5 lines of symmetry.

questions.question: Name the shapes of a stop sign and a yield sign and give the number of lines of symmetry of each.
questions.expected_answer: A stop sign is a regular octagon with 8 lines of symmetry. A yield sign is a triangle with 3 equal sides, which has 3 lines of symmetry.

questions.question: Describe an Ndebele house painting in maths words.
questions.expected_answer: It uses bold black straight lines outlining shapes such as rectangles, triangles and steps in bright colours. The shapes repeat, and the design often has a vertical line of symmetry through the doorway, so the left side matches the right.
